_meta.purpose: Asset tax character per symbol. Drives descriptive labels only - nothing here feeds the optimizer or computes a tax figure.
_meta.why_a_list: No API supplies this. Pattern matching over company names was tried and failed in both directions: it missed VNQ, XLRE, LQD and EMB, and it matched MA, QCOM, TXN and UNH on the word 'Incorporated'. Every entry below is hand-reviewed.
_meta.default: Symbols absent from `symbols` are treated as `equity`.
_meta.scope: General characterisations, not advice. Rules marked `us` do not apply outside the United States.
_meta.maintenance: When adding tickers to tickers.json, classify any REIT, bond, commodity, crypto or futures product here. Getting it wrong mislabels, it does not miscalculate.

equity.label: Equity
equity.income: Dividends, if any, may be qualified when the holding-period rules are met.
equity.us: Qualified dividends are taxed at long-term capital-gains rates; non-qualified at ordinary rates.

reit.label: REIT
reit.income: Distributions are largely ordinary income rather than qualified dividends.
reit.us: REIT distributions are mostly non-qualified and taxed at ordinary rates. Part may be return of capital, which lowers your cost basis instead of being taxed now.

bond.label: Bond fund
bond.income: Distributions are interest income, generally taxed at ordinary rates rather than dividend rates.
bond.us: Interest is taxed at ordinary rates. Treasury interest is generally exempt from state and local tax.

precious_metal.label: Precious metal trust
precious_metal.income: Physically backed metal trusts are often taxed less favourably than equities.
precious_metal.us: The IRS treats these as collectibles: long-term gains can be taxed up to 28%, not the usual 15/20% long-term rate.

commodity_futures.label: Commodity futures fund
commodity_futures.income: Futures-based funds frequently have their own tax regime and reporting.
commodity_futures.us: Often structured as partnerships issuing a Schedule K-1 rather than a 1099, with Section 1256 60/40 treatment - gains are split 60% long-term and 40% short-term regardless of holding period.

crypto_etp.label: Crypto ETP
crypto_etp.income: Treatment varies by structure and is still developing.
crypto_etp.us: Spot trusts are generally grantor trusts; futures-based products may fall under Section 1256. Structures differ product to product.

volatility.label: Volatility futures
volatility.income: Futures-based, with its own reporting regime.
volatility.us: Typically Section 1256 60/40 treatment and K-1 reporting. Designed for short holding periods.

target_date.label: Target-date fund
target_date.income: Holds a blend of equities and bonds, so distributions mix qualified dividends with interest income.
target_date.us: The mix shifts toward bonds as the target year approaches, so the share taxed as ordinary income tends to grow over time.
